summary: Defines the CHILDREN extension for IMAP4, which lets a client learn whether a mailbox has child mailboxes without issuing separate LIST commands for each one. The document title says Message Action Protocol, but the protocol is the Internet Message Access Protocol.

eli5.summary: Mail folders can contain more folders. This extension lets a mail program ask in one go which folders have sub-folders, instead of opening each to check.

questions: what is the imap children extension
how to check if an imap mailbox has children
